newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme to buy Neozyme II at $45 per unit.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme to buy Neozyme II at $45 per unit.

text.p: Genzyme Corp., a biotechnology company, said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire all outstanding units of Neozyme II Corp. in a cash tender offer worth $45 apiece or about $108 million.
Neozyme II was formed in 1992 to conduct research, development and clinical testing of products for the treatment of cystic fibrosis under contract with Genzyme.

Each Neozyme unit consists of one callable common share, one callable warrant to buy two common shares of Genzyme General Division and 0.135 common share of Genzyme Tissue Repair Division. Neozyme II has about 2.4 million callable common shares outstanding.
Genzyme said it expects the deal to close later this year.
Neozyme's stock rose $1.25 cents to $45.50, while Genzyme slipped 37.5 cents to $22.25 on Nasdaq at mid-afternoon.
